Vigilantes are members of the crew who are tasked with taking down people who have taken the life of another. Note that this is not necessarily a traitor or other evil organization, but rather just a person who has killed someone, regardless of mask.
In order to help with this, Vigilantes receive a cache with a random assortment of gear.
Be aware: a Vigilante has no way of determining [italic]who[/italic] has actually killed someone, so they'll need to rely on observation and communication in order to complete their goal. If all else fails, taking a stab at trying to kill a more powerful job like a security officer, captain, or coroner may lead to success.
